text: dsh-phone（DSH 插件，web 客户端）：把手机连接到运行 dsh web 的电脑，让你在手机上继续使用电脑中的 dsh 会话。它在 dsh web 侧栏增加「手机连接」页面，并提供 opentandem 命令打开配对入口。用户点击显示二维码后，可在手机浏览器打开二维码链接、登录 OpenTandem 并允许连接；页面显示配对状态，也支持取消或切换账号。适合希望从手机访问电脑上 dsh 工作会话的用户。首次配对默认从 opentandem.org 获取命令行启动器；也可配置自有服务器或本地启动器，无需额外 API key。

dsh-phone pairs a phone with dsh web through a QR code and OpenTandem sign-in. Its sidebar page shows pairing status and lets you cancel or switch accounts, so you can continue dsh sessions from your phone. The launcher downloads from opentandem.org by default; no API key is needed.
想用手机继续电脑上正在进行的 dsh 会话。
怎么扫码把手机和 dsh web 配对？
I want to send tasks to my computer’s dsh from my phone.
dsh-phone 的功能「手机二维码配对」：在 dsh web 侧栏打开手机连接页面，点击显示二维码，再用手机登录并确认连接。页面展示二维码和配对状态，并可取消等待或切换账号。
dsh-phone 首次配对默认从 opentandem.org 下载启动器并保存到用户目录；可配置服务器或本地启动器（见 lib/index.js:46-67）。

dsh-phone README · dsh-phone：Use [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) from your phone. Scan a QR code in `dsh web`, sign in to [OpenTandem](https://opentandem.org) on the phone, tap **Allow**, and send tasks to the computer that runs `dsh`. Your existing `dsh` sessions show up on the phone, and the phone and the computer continue the same session.

[中文说明](README.zh-CN.md)

dsh-phone README · Install：From npm:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-phone
```

From GitHub:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:opentandem/dsh-phone
```

You can also open **Plugins → Add plugin** in `dsh web`, enter `dsh-phone`, install it and press **Enable now**. If the **Phone** entry does not appear in the sidebar, refresh the page once.

dsh-phone README · Use：1. Click **Phone** in the `dsh web` sidebar and press **Show QR code**.

2. Scan the code with your phone and open it in the browser.

3. Sign in to OpenTandem on the phone and tap **Allow**.

4. The page in `dsh web` shows that the computer is connected.

5. Open OpenTandem on the phone. The project folders that `dsh` uses and their recent sessions are added to the task list, and you can continue them or start new ones.
dsh-phone README · Use：To connect another account, press **Switch account** on the page. The current connection stays until you tap **Allow** on the phone.

dsh-phone README · What it installs and sends：This plugin is a small page and a pairing step. The part that keeps the phone connected is the OpenTandem command line, which is a separate program, so you should know what it does before you press **Show QR code**:

dsh-phone README · What it installs and sends：| What | Details |
|---|---|
| Download | The first time, the plugin downloads the launcher from `https://opentandem.org/api/cli-script?file=launcher.mjs` to `~/.opentandem-dsh/` and runs it on the Node.js that runs `dsh`. The launcher installs the OpenTandem command line, which takes about a minute. |
| Background service | The command line starts a background Runner that stays installed, so the phone can reach this computer after `dsh web` is closed. Remove it with `opentandem uninstall`, or remove the computer in the OpenTandem settings. |
| What the phone can do | After you tap **Allow**, tasks sent from that OpenTandem account run on this computer through `dsh`. Allow it only if you started the pairing yourself. |
| Accounts | You sign in on the phone, so this plugin never sees your OpenTandem account or password. It does not use your DeepSeek account. Tasks use the models you have already set up in `dsh`. |
| Connection check | Every route of this plugin sits behind the connection check that `dsh` uses for its own APIs, and the POST routes only accept `application/json`. |
dsh-phone README · What it installs and sends：The source of the [OpenTandem Runner and command line](https://github.com/opentandem/opentandem) is public under AGPL-3.0.

dsh-phone README · Configuration：| Environment variable | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `OPENTANDEM_CLI` | Use this launcher or `opentandem` executable instead of downloading one. |
| `OPENTANDEM_SERVER` | The OpenTandem server to download from and pair with. The default is `https://opentandem.org`. |
dsh-phone README · Compatibility：This plugin has been tested on macOS with `dsh` 0.2.1-rc.2 and 0.2.2-rc.1. Windows and Linux have not been tested yet.

dsh-phone README · About OpenTandem：**OpenTandem is a unified workspace for individuals and teams that manages multiple AI coding agents, with mobile access.**
**One workspace, all your machines, with agent switching, model routing, live quota tracking, and team collaboration.**
dsh-phone README · License：MIT. The OpenTandem command line and Runner are separate AGPL-3.0 programs that this plugin only starts as a child process, and none of their code is bundled here.

dsh-phone README · dsh-phone：在手机上使用 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（`dsh`）。在 `dsh web` 里扫描二维码，在手机上登录 [OpenTandem](https://opentandem.org) 并点「允许」，就能把任务发给运行 `dsh` 的这台电脑。电脑上已有的 `dsh` 会话会出现在手机上，手机和电脑接着同一个会话聊。

[English](README.md)

dsh-phone README · 安装：从 npm 安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-phone
```

从 GitHub 安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:opentandem/dsh-phone
```

也可以在 `dsh web` 里打开「插件 → 添加插件」，输入 `dsh-phone`，安装后点「立即启用」。如果侧栏没有出现「手机连接」，刷新一次页面。

dsh-phone README · 使用：1. 点 `dsh web` 侧栏的「手机连接」，再点「显示二维码」。
2. 用手机扫描二维码，用浏览器打开。
3. 在手机上登录 OpenTandem，点「允许」。
4. `dsh web` 的页面会显示这台电脑已经连接。
5. 在手机上打开 OpenTandem。`dsh` 用过的项目目录和其中最近的会话会自动添加到任务列表，可以接着聊，也可以新建任务。

要连接其他账号，在页面上点「换账号连接」。在手机上点「允许」之前，当前连接不受影响。

截图见[英文说明](README.md#use)。

dsh-phone README · 它会安装什么、发送什么：| 项目 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 下载 | 第一次使用时，插件从 `https://opentandem.org/api/cli-script?file=launcher.mjs` 下载启动器到 `~/.opentandem-dsh/`，用运行 `dsh` 的 Node.js 执行。启动器会安装 OpenTandem 命令行，大约需要一分钟。 |
| 后台服务 | 命令行会启动一个常驻后台的 Runner，关掉 `dsh web` 之后手机仍然能连到这台电脑。可以用 `opentandem uninstall` 卸载，也可以在 OpenTandem 设置里删除这台电脑。 |
| 手机能做什么 | 点「允许」之后，从该 OpenTandem 账号发出的任务会通过 `dsh` 在这台电脑上运行。只有配对是你自己发起的才应该允许。 |
| 账号 | 登录发生在手机上，所以插件不接触你的 OpenTandem 账号和密码，也不使用你的 DeepSeek 账号。任务使用你在 `dsh` 里已经配置好的模型。 |
| 连接校验 | 插件的所有路由都经过 `dsh` 自己接口使用的连接校验，POST 路由只接受 `application/json`。 |
